subject: English
question_text: Add tag questions to the statements below: 1 5=5
stimulus: a) Everybody wants to have a better life, ____? b) A better life seldom comes without hard work, ____? c) We have to work for this, ____? d) But most of us can hardly do the job, ____? e) Actually, life isn't a bed of roses, ____?
guide_solution: Add tag questions: (a) Everybody wants to have a better life, don’t they? (b) A better life seldom comes without hard work, does it? (c) We have to work for this, don’t we? (d) But most of us can hardly do the job, can we? (e) Actually, life isn’t a bed of roses, is it?
